title: Authentik
description: Authentik, which signs everyone in (R40): whether its server and worker are up, sign-ins that worked and failed (by reason, never who), its requests, flows and worker tasks, its errors and its database connections (R89a, R89b).

options.content:
Authentik has two parts. The **server** answers the sign-in pages and PagerArchive's questions: while it's down, nobody can sign in. The **worker** runs background tasks, such as sending emails (codes, invitations): while it's down, sign-ins work but no email goes out. **Up** is red for either one the stack can't reach (the "Authentik down" alert).

**Sign-ins** come from Authentik's event log, counted each minute over the 5 minutes before, so one sign-in shows for 5 minutes. A failed one says only where it failed: the **password**, the **second factor** (Authentik's own admin), or **other**. Never who, or from where. A few failures are people mistyping; a burst is someone guessing (the "Failed sign-ins" alert), and the guessing protection locks each account after 5 (R44a). **Errors** are what Authentik recorded as going wrong: its admin interface (Events → Logs) has the detail.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Whether the stack can scrape Authentik's server and worker (port 9300, over the monitoring-authentik network). Normal: both up. Worry: DOWN, which fires "Authentik down" after a minute. "Not watched" when the stack doesn't scrape Authentik.

panels.title: Workers connected
panels.description: Worker processes the server sees. Normal: 1 or more. Worry: 0 while the worker is up: it can't reach the database, and tasks (emails) queue up.

panels.title: Signed in, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Sign-ins that worked in the last 5 minutes, from Authentik's event log (R89b). Normal: a few when people sign in, else 0 (sessions last). Worry: a steady stream nobody explains: check Authentik's Events → Logs.

panels.title: Failed sign-ins, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Sign-ins that failed in the last 5 minutes, any reason. Normal: 0 to a few (mistyped passwords). Worry: orange from 5; red above 10, when "Failed sign-ins" fires.

panels.title: Accounts locked
panels.description: Accounts the guessing protection has locked now (R44a): 5 wrong passwords or codes in 15 minutes lock one for 15 minutes. Normal: 0. Worry: several at once.

panels.title: Sign-ins (each minute, over the 5 minutes before)
panels.description: Sign-ins that worked, and failed ones by where they failed: password, second factor, or other (R89b). Counted each minute over the 5 minutes before, so a burst shows as a plateau 5 minutes wide. Normal: small bumps. Worry: failed ones climbing past 10 ("Failed sign-ins" fires).

panels.title: Errors Authentik recorded (each minute, over the 5 minutes before)
panels.description: From Authentik's event log, by kind (R89b): system_exception (Authentik itself failed), system_task_exception (a worker task failed, such as an email), configuration_error, policy_exception and property_mapping_exception. Normal: 0. Worry: anything above 0: Authentik's admin interface, Events → Logs, says what.

panels.title: Requests per second, by status
panels.description: Requests Authentik's server answered, by HTTP status: the sign-in pages, PagerArchive's questions (tokens, users, invitations) and the admin interface. Normal: mostly 200 and 302, some 4xx (an expired session). Worry: any 5xx.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx) by view (per minute)
panels.description: Requests that ended with a 5xx status, per minute, by Authentik's view (its name for the page or API endpoint) and status. Normal: nothing. Worry: any line.

panels.title: Slowest 10% of requests, by view
panels.description: How long the slowest 10 % of requests to each of Authentik's views took, for the views used. Normal: tens of milliseconds; a password check is meant to be slow (it hashes), about a quarter of a second. Worry: seconds, for minutes on end.

panels.title: Flows started (per minute)
panels.description: Flows Authentik started, by flow: pagerarchive-authentication a sign-in, pagerarchive-enrolment a new account from an invitation, pagerarchive-recovery a forgotten password. Starts, not completions: the sign-in panels say how they ended. Normal: a few when people sign in. Worry: a steady stream of sign-ins with failed sign-ins climbing.

panels.title: Worker tasks (per minute)
panels.description: Background tasks the worker ran, per minute, and those that failed, were retried or were given up on (rejected). Normal: a steady trickle of housekeeping, nothing failed. Worry: failed or rejected: Authentik's admin interface (System → Tasks) says why; a rejected task is lost.

panels.title: Tasks that failed (time range)
panels.description: The worker's tasks that failed in the dashboard's time range, by task. Normal: empty. Worry: any row. A task's first failure after Authentik starts isn't counted here (the counter starts at it); the errors panel counts every one.

panels.title: Tasks waiting
panels.description: Tasks queued for the worker and not started yet, and those running. Normal: near 0. Worry: a queue that grows and doesn't empty: the worker is down or stuck.

panels.title: Database: new connections and errors (per minute)
panels.description: Connections Authentik's server and worker opened to the database, per minute, and database errors by kind. Normal: a few at start, then almost none (Authentik keeps its connections). Worry: a steady stream of new ones, or any errors: the database is restarting or unreachable (Authentik reconnects within about a minute).
